errors.evidence: The chart shows four company size categories ("Betriebsgrößenklassen"), not three. The four categories are Größere Betriebe (250+), Mittlere Betriebe (50-249), Kleinbetriebe (10-49), and Kleinstbetriebe (1-9).

errors.text_span: die Kategorien sind nicht alphabetisch, sondern nach abnehmendem Betroffenheitsanteil sortiert
errors.evidence: This statement is an over-generalization. The first group of categories (industry sectors) is sorted by decreasing value, but the second group (company sizes) is not. In the second group, 'Mittlere Betriebe' (approx. 39%) has a higher value than 'Größere Betriebe' (approx. 36%), but is listed below it.

errors.text_span: „Baugewerbe“ und „Finanz- und Versicherungsgewerbe“ liegen mit jeweils etwa 10 %
errors.evidence: The description states that these two categories are 'each about 10%'. However, 'Baugewerbe' is clearly below 10% (at approx. 9%), while 'Finanz- und Versicherungsgewerbe' is clearly above 10% (at approx. 11%).
The description provides values for three of the four company size categories but omits the value for 'Kleinbetriebe (10-49)', which is approximately 30%.
The bar for 'Einzelhandel' ends visibly below the 40% mark, at approximately 38-39%.
The value for 'Mittlere Betriebe (50-249)' is closer to 39% than 38%.
